fn main() {
    let texts = vec_str("7", "x", "9", "?")
    let mut sum = 0
    let mut count = 0
    for text in texts {
        match parse_int(text) {
            Some(num) => {
                sum = sum + num
            },
            None => {
                count = count + 1
            },
        }
    }
    print(sum)
    print(count)
}

fn vec_str(s1: &Str, s2: &Str, s3: &Str, s4: &Str) -> Vec<Str> {
    vec(s1, s2, s3, s4)
}

fn parse_int(s: &Str) -> Option<Int> {
    if letOk(n) == s.to_int() {
        Some(n)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn to_int(s: &Str) -> Result<Int, Str> {
    match s.parse() {
        Ok(n) => Ok(n),
        Err(_) => Err(s.clone()),
    }
}

fn letOk(result: Result<T, E>) -> Option<T> {
    match result {
        Ok(val) => Some(val),
        Err(_) => None,
    }
}
